universe.name: Chiseled History Studios
universe.why: San Marino was founded by a stonemason and survived by being an immovable rock while empires crashed around it. A universe of carved marble, limestone, and granite perfectly captures centuries of stoic endurance.
universe.pacing: Steady, monumental, and stoic, with the heavy, deliberate rhythm of sliding stone blocks.
universe.signature_shot: A tiny, pristine marble mountain fortress bathed in warm light, surrounded by the shattered, dusty ruins of Roman columns and imperial statues.
universe.medium_break: A giant steel sculptor's chisel suddenly strikes an 'empire' statue from off-screen, shattering it into white stone dust.
universe.look_bible: Classical marble and stone relief diorama. Materials: polished white Carrara marble, rough-hewn granite, dark slate, and terracotta. Palette: ivory white, slate gray, warm terracotta, and subtle gold veins. Lighting: warm, directional museum spotlighting casting deep, dramatic shadows, with dust motes drifting in volumetric light. Lens: macro photography with shallow depth of field. Texture: visible chisel marks, stone dust, and smooth polished surfaces. Motion feels heavy, architectural, and stoic.
universe.penguin_render: Carved from smooth black basalt and white marble, with slightly polished amber-orange stone for feet and beak. Three thin wire-like metal feathers sticking out of its stone head.
universe.music: Slow, resonant cello and sparse harp plucks, echoing like a grand marble museum hall.

penguin.arc: Wants to fly but is made of solid, heavy basalt stone; tries to flap its stone flippers while standing guard, fails entirely, and just accepts gravity.

shots.motion: Camera pulls back slowly, expanding the view from the marble fortress to reveal the steep granite cliffs.
Camera continues pulling back smoothly, revealing the terracotta map of Italy wrapping completely around the mountain base.
Camera tilts down rapidly to the base of the mountain as the stone mason statue strikes the chisel, puffing white dust.
Camera pushes in slightly as the massive Roman column shatters into white dust and crumbles away to reveal the mountain.
Camera drifts left as the dark slate Bishop piece violently slides onto the mountain peak.
Camera tilts down following the action as the mountain tilts and the slate piece slides off into the shadows.
Camera pushes in slowly on the blueprint as the golden eagle icon expands its glowing gold borders toward the mountain.
Camera drifts up slightly as a thick white chalk wall snaps into place around the mountain, halting the gold lines.
Camera pushes in slightly on the door as it cracks open to reveal the statue inside, while the stone penguin struggles and drops its flippers.
Camera pans smoothly right, leaving the door to follow the rigid marble soldier statues marching past.
Camera holds the pan as focus shifts, watching the marble soldiers recede and disappear into the shadows.
Camera pushes in slowly as the marble statues seamlessly slide out and are replaced by new ones.
Camera pans down quickly to the stone tablet as the chisel strikes the new tally mark.
Camera pulls back rapidly from the tablet to a grand wide shot of the entire mountain amidst the ruins.
Camera drifts up slightly as the lighting transitions to a rich, warm golden glow on the fortress.
